sources: Flare 2.0 热身 v2 / 练后三档 2026-11-21（Google 表 1aCseEk4vslsG-QKb-zsZwg30amvoYh5tMxzy6p9n8vA，练后：站姿屈腕拉伸（无墙））

purpose.zh: 拉开前臂内侧和手腕，撑地训练后放松
purpose.en: Stretches the inside of the forearm and wrist after hand-support training.

text.zh: 手臂伸直掌心朝前，另一手把手指往回拉
text.en: Arm straight, palm out, other hand draws fingers back

text.zh: 手臂伸直抬到肩高，手腕往上翻，掌心朝前，指尖朝下。
text.en: Straight arm at shoulder height, palm facing forward, fingertips pointing down.

text.zh: 另一只手握住手指，轻轻往身体方向拉，前臂里面有拉的感觉就够了。
text.en: The other hand holds the fingers and gently draws them toward you until the inner forearm stretches.

text.zh: 手肘一直伸直，肩膀放松。
text.en: Keep the elbow straight and the shoulder relaxed.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺疼就拉轻一点；有腕伤先问医生
cautions.en: If your wrist feels sharp pain, pull less; check with a doctor if you have a wrist injury.

flare2.item: 练后：站姿屈腕拉伸（无墙）
flare2.camera: 右侧前方（看得到腕背伸角度和伸直的手肘）
flare2.doseBrief: 表：静态保持，左右各一次；草稿每侧 30 秒 1 组（秒数待定）；动画右手示范，App 镜像
flare2.note: Animation r2: right arm only (one-sided, the app mirrors for the left). 8 s loop: draw back 0.6-1.8 s, hold to 6.6 s, ease off. Finger poses V5-only.

set.zh: 手臂伸直到肩高，掌心朝前
set.en: Arm straight at shoulder height, palm forward

set.zh: 前臂里面有拉的感觉就够了，别使劲拽
set.en: A gentle pull inside the forearm is enough

set.zh: 手肘一直伸直，肩膀放松

sides.note: 一侧全部组做完再换边；换边准备 10 秒（training.sideSwitchSeconds，App 未接入）
